name: Filter driers & accumulators
description: Keep moisture, dirt and liquid refrigerant away from the compressor.
long_description: Filter driers trap moisture, acid and debris in the refrigerant, and should be replaced whenever the system is opened for repair. Suction accumulators stop liquid refrigerant from reaching the compressor. Both protect the compressor from early failure.

parts.name: Filter driers
parts.detail: Liquid line and suction line driers in flare and solder types.
parts.summary: Filter driers remove moisture, acid and dirt from the refrigerant. Moisture causes ice blockages and acid that damages compressors, so a new drier should be fitted every time the system is opened.
specs: Molecular sieve, with activated alumina for acid on some types
Liquid line (one-way), bi-flow (heat pumps), suction line (clean-up)
Copper capillary driers for split and window ACs
Compatible with HCFC and HFC refrigerants
notes: Fit the drier last and keep it sealed until then: it starts absorbing moisture once opened
Use a bi-flow drier on heat pump systems

parts.name: Suction accumulators
parts.detail: Protect the compressor from liquid refrigerant at start-up.
parts.summary: Suction accumulators sit before the compressor and hold back liquid refrigerant and oil, letting only vapour through. They protect the compressor from liquid slugging, especially in heat pumps and systems with long pipe runs.
specs: Steel shell with U-tube outlet and oil-return orifice
By system capacity, refrigerant charge and connection size
notes: Mount vertically, close to the compressor suction

signs: Frost or a temperature drop across the drier
System opened for a leak or compressor repair
